summary: Built a small Node.js sample app that demonstrates product recommendations using Azure DocumentDB vector search. The sample seeds 10,000 products (with embeddings) and 20,000 orders into the database sample_retail_02, creates a DiskANN vector index on products.embedding, and implements a simple agent-like recommendation flow (vector search + co-purchase re-ranking + per-session memory persisted in DocumentDB). The app supports real embeddings and reasoning via OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is present, and falls back to deterministic synthetic embeddings and template reasoning when the key is missing. Seed, index creation and a one-shot vector-search verification were executed successfully against the live cluster.
how_to_run:
1) Copy .env.example to .env and set DOCUMENTDB_URI (and optionally OPENAI_API_KEY).
2) npm install
3) npm run seed   # inserts 10k products (with embeddings) and 20k orders and creates the DiskANN index
4) npm start      # starts the web UI on port 3000 (serves public/index.html and /api/recommend)

Notes: If OPENAI_API_KEY is not set the sample uses deterministic synthetic embeddings and templated reasoning. Product IDs seeded are P0..P9999. The server persists per-session memory in the 'sessions' collection using a sessionId cookie.
